scope: Five homepage entry routes and 18 generated catalogue front doors. Product internals, nested routes, remote services and runtime states are excluded.

checks.negative: Broken/duplicate skip destinations, missing alt, missing/empty language, absent scope policy, opaque-script/comment bait and template markup cannot gain automatic assurance. Wrong scope/kind and incomplete or ambiguous receipts remain blocked.
checks.serialization: Differential portable-tree and rejection tests preserve the shared HTML serializer semantics; guards avoid redundant deep comparisons.
checks.compatibility: Existing identity JSON routes and per-product profile saga fields retained.

browser.desktop: Ivory/teal shield design, distinct topic colours, evidence level bars and expandable product panels.
browser.contrast: Legacy identity status tiles changed to dark teal on pale green; human evidence and policy/implementation gaps are separate.

boundary: Evidence levels apply only to their declared scopes. These checks do not establish WCAG conformance, semantic fitness, authenticated application behaviour or promised locale support. No human/use/maintenance receipts are supplied. Shared observations are one evidence family.
